options: 記錄每次緩衝位址、裝置與生命週期；以CPU參考確認前一步輸出就是下一步輸入。
偶發錯誤可能是提早釋放或尚未完成的非同步資料；若仍有複製，查輸入實際仍在CPU。
以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 10次裝置計算各1 ms；傳入與傳出各0.5 ms，未綁定時每次都搬移。
optionsEn: Record buffer addresses, devices and lifetimes, and confirm chaining against a CPU reference.
Intermittent errors suggest premature release or asynchronous readiness; remaining copies may reflect CPU-resident inputs.

All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Ten device steps1 ms each; upload/download0.5 ms each, repeated every step without binding.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「獨立驗證方法」。記錄每次緩衝位址、裝置與生命週期；以CPU參考確認前一步輸出就是下一步輸入。 與本階段判準一起判讀：只消除可省的複製，不把初始上傳或最後下載排除在使用者延遲之外。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies independent verification. Record buffer addresses, devices and lifetimes, and confirm chaining against a CPU reference. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Remove only avoidable copies, without hiding initial upload/final download from user latency.

steps.title: 駐留生命週期 · 比較擾動與量測
steps.titleEn: Residency lifetimes · Compare perturbations and measurements
steps.objective: 完成「駐留生命週期」的比較擾動與量測，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete compare perturbations and measurements for Residency lifetimes and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
記錄每次緩衝位址、裝置與生命週期；以CPU參考確認前一步輸出就是下一步輸入。
回到本階段實驗：畫CPU輸入→裝置十步→CPU輸出，逐箭頭註記實際複製。 ONNX Runtime I/O Binding可指定裝置上的輸入輸出；本課研究連續推論管線的資料生命週期。
把名義組與變更組並列，逐欄確認只改了預定條件；若需多變量，另開實驗編號。用同一單位檢查趨勢、偏差與判準：只消除可省的複製，不把初始上傳或最後下載排除在使用者延遲之外。
steps.instructionEn:
Record buffer addresses, devices and lifetimes, and confirm chaining against a CPU reference.
Return to the investigation: Draw CPU input→ten device steps→CPU output, marking actual copies. ONNX Runtime I/O Binding specifies device inputs/outputs; this lab studies lifetimes in chained inference.
Compare nominal and changed runs column by column, confirming that only intended conditions changed. Give multi-variable experiments separate IDs. Check trend, bias, and criterion in common units: Remove only avoidable copies, without hiding initial upload/final download from user latency.
steps.observation: 對照組與變更組的差異能追到明確輸入或量測機制。記錄每次緩衝位址、裝置與生命週期；以CPU參考確認前一步輸出就是下一步輸入。
steps.observationEn: Differences between control and changed runs trace to explicit inputs or measurement mechanisms. Record buffer addresses, devices and lifetimes, and confirm chaining against a CPU reference.
steps.failure: 同時變更多個輸入卻把結果歸因於單一因素。
steps.failureEn: Changing multiple inputs and attributing the output difference to a single factor.
steps.check: 只消除可省的複製，不把初始上傳或最後下載排除在使用者延遲之外。
steps.checkEn: Remove only avoidable copies, without hiding initial upload/final download from user latency.

quiz.questionEn: Residency lifetimes: Which statement identifies an anomaly mechanism or competing explanation that cannot be treated as successful acceptance?
options: 交付駐留地圖、複製次數、生命週期及端到端計時。
偶發錯誤可能是提早釋放或尚未完成的非同步資料；若仍有複製，查輸入實際仍在CPU。
optionsEn: Unbound total=10×(1+0.5+0.5)=20 ms.
Deliver residency map, copy counts, lifetimes and end-to-end timing.
Intermittent errors suggest premature release or asynchronous readiness; remaining copies may reflect CPU-resident inputs.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「故障與替代解釋」。偶發錯誤可能是提早釋放或尚未完成的非同步資料；若仍有複製，查輸入實際仍在CPU。 與本階段判準一起判讀：只消除可省的複製，不把初始上傳或最後下載排除在使用者延遲之外。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies fault and competing explanation. Intermittent errors suggest premature release or asynchronous readiness; remaining copies may reflect CPU-resident inputs. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Remove only avoidable copies, without hiding initial upload/final download from user latency.

steps.title: 駐留生命週期 · 分辨異常成因
steps.titleEn: Residency lifetimes · Discriminate anomaly causes
steps.objective: 完成「駐留生命週期」的分辨異常成因，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Residency lifetimes and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
偶發錯誤可能是提早釋放或尚未完成的非同步資料；若仍有複製，查輸入實際仍在CPU。
對照「駐留生命週期」的名義結果，分別建立物理故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。保留緩衝至所有消費完成，對可變輸出形狀使用合法配置，量測全鏈而非只Run。
本階段必須重驗：只消除可省的複製，不把初始上傳或最後下載排除在使用者延遲之外。
steps.instructionEn:
Intermittent errors suggest premature release or asynchronous readiness; remaining copies may reflect CPU-resident inputs.
Against the nominal Residency lifetimes result, build competing physical-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Retain buffers through consumption, allocate variable outputs correctly, and time the full chain.
Reverify this criterion: Remove only avoidable copies, without hiding initial upload/final download from user latency.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。偶發錯誤可能是提早釋放或尚未完成的非同步資料；若仍有複製，查輸入實際仍在CPU。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Intermittent errors suggest premature release or asynchronous readiness; remaining copies may reflect CPU-resident inputs.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 只消除可省的複製，不把初始上傳或最後下載排除在使用者延遲之外。
steps.checkEn: Remove only avoidable copies, without hiding initial upload/final download from user latency.

steps.title: 駐留生命週期 · 驗收並留下交接件
steps.titleEn: Residency lifetimes · Accept and hand over evidence
steps.objective: 完成「駐留生命週期」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Residency lifetimes and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付駐留地圖、複製次數、生命週期及端到端計時。
在交接件中加入「駐留生命週期」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：只消除可省的複製，不把初始上傳或最後下載排除在使用者延遲之外。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：只消除可省的複製，不把初始上傳或最後下載排除在使用者延遲之外。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver residency map, copy counts, lifetimes and end-to-end timing.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Residency lifetimes: Remove only avoidable copies, without hiding initial upload/final download from user latency.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Remove only avoidable copies, without hiding initial upload/final download from user latency. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。只消除可省的複製，不把初始上傳或最後下載排除在使用者延遲之外。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Remove only avoidable copies, without hiding initial upload/final download from user latency.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.

steps.checkEn: Remove only avoidable copies, without hiding initial upload/final download from user latency.
